stories.title: Suspect charged in 2025 fatal shooting of man outside west Louisville Wendy's
stories.summary: Police say they have taken Marcus Greene into custody nearly two years after a man died following a shooting inside a West Broadway Wendy's parking lot.

stories.title: Greater Clark County Schools announce death of School Board member
stories.summary: Greater Clark County Schools announced on Facebook that the District 6 Board member passed away.

stories.title: Man reported missing in Louisville arrested in central Kentucky after Saturday night police chase
stories.summary: Tyler Damron, 31, was reported missing in Louisville on Friday. The next day, he ended up behind bars after leading police on a chase.

stories.title: Rae Hofelich selected as interim mayor of Charlestown
stories.summary: Hofelich will assume the role Dec. 1 and serve the remainder of Mayor Treva Hodges’ term, which ends Dec. 31, 2027.

stories.title: Stork dies of bird flu at Louisville Zoo, new precautionary measures implemented
stories.summary: Precautionary measures were taken after a wild Canada goose on the Zoo grounds tested positive for the bird flu, and they will reimplement those temporary measures.

stories.title: Golden Alert cancelled for man last seen in California neighborhood
stories.summary: Louisville Metro Police said 74-year-old Jerry Abbott was found and is safe.

stories.title: Residents in Louisville express concerns over increasing short-term rentals
stories.summary: Two new short-term rentals come to Louisville despite community concerns.

stories.title: Louisville's Metro Council sees no partisan shift as president decides to not seek another year
stories.summary: The next president will need 14 votes to take the seat.

stories.title: Gunfire exchange precedes rollover crash in Jeffersonville, police say
stories.summary: Police say a Sunday evening rollover incident on Hamburg Pike was due to an exchange of gunfire.

stories.title: Southern Indiana firefighters, families invited to Colts' Salute to Service game
stories.summary: Seymour firefighters and their families were invited to the Indianapolis Colts versus Miami Dolphins game at Lucas Oil Stadium on Sunday.

stories.title: Man, woman charged after robbery at housing complex in Park Hill
stories.summary: Terrell White and Jessica Robbins, both 47, face charges of burglary and robbery after allegedly threatening a woman with a gun in her Park Hill apartment.

stories.title: $100K winning Powerball ticket sold in this Kentucky city
stories.summary: The current Powerball jackpot is estimated at $76 million, and the next drawing will take place on Monday at 11 p.m.
